scope: Eager training FWD + tape release + device synchronize, with online source quantization and retained column FP8 X/BF16 AB; excludes backward, optimizer and one-time FP8 weight preparation.
method: 20 warmups + 50 variable-token/route samples, two runs with reversed variant order; median of 100 per-sample slowest-rank times. All workload hashes, token arrays and received-row arrays match across variants/repeats.
implementation: Same-stream standalone source quantization before Notify; peer Pull copies FP8+FP32 scales; no BF16 X checkpoint. Existing row-to-column FP8 cache and BF16 dW retained.
limitations: Single-node N256 path only; GIN and other tiles retain old path and are not runtime-tested here.
These measurements do not establish full training-step speedups.
